title: External effect supervisor
description: Objective: implement atomic work claim, lease/slot/budget reservation, effect intent, one-use activation, process observation, cancel, and restart reconciliation for one Claude node. Deliverable: runner supervisor modules and daemon work services. NOT in scope: multiple execution-bearing nodes, fan-in, Codex, or automatic approval. Hard dependencies: Lease presence core, Conserved budget core, Projection outbox core, Claude runtime adapter, and Planning graph lifecycle core. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/supervisor/** and apps/daemon/src/work/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: No external action occurs before effect.activate and attempt/effect become active together or neither.
Start/cancel/release/restart races end in one legal state with current token, epoch, budget, and runtime closure revalidated.
Duplicate delivery adopts the registered process or exits before provider launch; uncertainty is SUSPECT or UNKNOWN, never blind relaunch.
Both focused runner and daemon test commands exit 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
reopenReason: Promoted by governor-38d884e4 on human request, as a judgment call with a named risk — not a clean dependency pass. 4 of 5 hard deps are DONE: Lease presence core (task-967769ea), Conserved budget core (task-d5c4b086), Claude runtime adapter (task-5ff2b39d), Planning graph lifecycle core (task-1ade51c0). The 5th, Projection outbox core (task-55d5a898), is a SPIDR shell whose landed substance — projections, upcasters, transactional outbox relay — is already committed; only subscription cursors (step 4, in flight) and crash/rebuild hardening (step 5, PLANNING) remain. RATIONALE: this task's owned paths are packages/runner/src/supervisor/** and apps/daemon/src/work/**, disjoint from packages/store/**, and its scope (atomic work claim, lease/slot/budget reservation, one-use activation, process observation, restart reconciliation) reads current projection state rather than following a durable cursor feed. ARCHITECT: verify that assumption first. If planning shows this genuinely consumes subscription cursors or the crash/rebuild guarantees, report_blocked and I will move it back to BACKLOG - that is a cheap reversal, not a failure. CRITICAL priority and the second chokepoint on the board: it gates Codex runtime adapter, which in turn gates most of epic-f02c6977 and epic-bf111658.

comments.content: DECOMPOSITION SHELL (human-approved 4-child split, 2026-08-08). Governor's store-dependency question ANSWERED FIRST: the assumption HOLDS — design line 771 binds a predecessor cursor VALUE into EffectIntent; nothing here follows a subscription feed, and restart reconciliation (lines 786-787) re-derives from effect/attempt records, not store rebuild. No store-dep block. The task is instead not plannable as one unit: 7 concerns across 2 packages against the 12-step/10-file plan caps (lease core alone shipped 21 files). Children, dependency-ordered, all CRITICAL: 1) task-2580a578 Effect intent lifecycle and one-use activation gate; 2) task-4a3b5ec0 Launch lock, process adoption, drain and restart reconciliation (needs 1); 3) task-ba3a45f9 Daemon work services (needs 1-2; carries the human-approved ownership amendment: apps/daemon/package.json +@moe/runner and its single lockfile hunk); 4) task-49acb856 Supervisor race and restart hardening gate (needs 1-3; carries this parent's full DoD evidence and full regression). When all four are DONE, close this parent the two-step way — REVIEW as transit, labeled as such (see mem:moe-backlog-to-done-transition-blocked precedent from task-d5c4b086). Do not re-plan this shell.

blockedReason: Decomposition shell, NOT the store-dependency block you pre-authorized: your cursor assumption HOLDS (EffectIntent binds a predecessor cursor value, design 771; no subscription feed, no crash/rebuild dependency). Blocked because 7 concerns across 2 packages cannot fit one plan (12-step/10-file caps; lease core was 21 files). Human approved a 4-child SPIDR split, all created CRITICAL in dependency order: task-2580a578 (intent lifecycle + one-use activation) -> task-4a3b5ec0 (launch lock/adoption/drain/restart) -> task-ba3a45f9 (daemon work services; includes approved ownership amendment apps/daemon/package.json +@moe/runner + single lock hunk) -> task-49acb856 (race/restart hardening gate, carries this parent's full DoD). Child 1 is immediately plannable — deps task-5ff2b39d and task-967769ea are DONE. Promote task-2580a578 to PLANNING to keep the chokepoint moving; unblock this shell only when all four children are DONE, then close via labeled REVIEW-transit (task-d5c4b086 precedent). Details in comment-c866c1cc.
